name: Cool Hands Rex
bio: Shades on, collar up, and the steadiest trigger claw since the Cretaceous.
notes: Import list batch 1 (docs/IMPORT_LIST.md; "Cool TRex 10k", as Meshy names the download; rigged and animated on Meshy: Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; finger chains for the thumb, middle, ring and little finger but no index finger, so the fingers are re-fitted by hands.mjs; the tail's (Bone_015-Bone_020) and the jaw's and head's (Bone_034-Bone_039, headfront) extra joints ride the hips and the head; its two clips are not used). A T-rex in a dark bomber jacket, cargo trousers and sunglasses, with a long tail. Named by the owner (2026-11-06: "call him 'Cool Hands Rex', i made him in meshy"). A 10.4k-triangle download, kept whole; its two 4096 px maps baked down. Large for its heavy build. Licence: the owner's own Meshy model (owned).
